diffs.diff: pin count: part has 4 (+ - D C), datasheet reading has 5 (SCL SDA GND VIO VHI)
diffs.evidence: The second reading copied the pinout of the 14-segment Quad Alphanumeric backpack from the same Adafruit LED Backpack guide (its pages 55-56 list VIO/VCC, GND, SCL, SDA, plus 'VHi - This pin allows you to provide 5V to only the 14-segment displays'). The 0.56" 7-Segment Backpack section (page 86) gives a 4-pin header: 'Backpack + (VCC) to microcontroller 5V ... Backpack - (GND) to microcontroller GND ... Backpack D (SDA) to microcontroller SDA ... Backpack C (SCL) to microcontroller SCL', and page 89 says 'We'll assume you want to use a 4pin header'. The STEMMA QT revision is described as 'the same size and pinout as before'.

diffs.diff: maximum supply: part 5.5 V, datasheet reading 5 V
diffs.evidence: Holtek HT16K33 datasheet Rev 1.10, Features: 'Operating voltage: 4.5V~5.5V'; D.C. Characteristics table: 'VDD Operating Voltage  min 4.5  typ 5  max 5.5 V'. The second reading's 5 V is the typical value / Adafruit's '3-5V' board guidance, not the chip maximum; vmax 5.5 V matches the chip's absolute operating limit.
